name: Red-DiscordBot
author: support@raptorpanel.net
description: Red is a self-hosted, modular Discord bot for moderation, fun and more, extended with community cogs. It needs a Discord bot token.
startup: v="$(cat .red-version) $(python3 --version)"; if [ "$v" != "$(cat .venv/.raptor-installed 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "Installing Red-DiscordBot $(cat .red-version)"; { python3 -m venv --clear .venv && .venv/bin/pip install -q --no-cache-dir --disable-pip-version-check "Red-DiscordBot==$(cat .red-version)" && echo "$v" > .venv/.raptor-installed; } || exit 1; fi; cfg=.config/Red-DiscordBot/config.json; [ -f "$cfg" ] || .venv/bin/redbot-setup --no-prompt --instance-name red --data-path /home/container/data --backend json || exit 1; inst=$(.venv/bin/python -c "import json; print(next(iter(json.load(open('$cfg')))))"); if [ -z "$TOKEN" ]; then echo "Red needs a Discord bot token: set it in Startup, then restart the server."; exec sleep infinity; fi; export RED_TOKEN="$TOKEN"; exec .venv/bin/python -O -m redbot "$inst" --no-prompt --prefix "{{PREFIX}}" ${OWNER:+--owner "$OWNER"}

config.startup: {"done": ["regex:Loaded \\d+ cogs with \\d+ commands", "Red needs a Discord bot token"]}

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Red-DiscordBot: checks the chosen version on PyPI. Red itself is installed
# when the server starts, into its own Python environment (.venv), for the
# Python version it runs. Your bot's data and settings are never touched.
set -euo pipefail
cd /mnt/server
# Downloads unpack in a folder in the server's (the install's /tmp is
# small), removed when the script ends.
work=/mnt/server/.raptor-build
rm -rf "$work" && mkdir -p "$work"
trap 'rm -rf "$work"' EXIT
fail() { echo "$1"; exit 1; }
want="${VERSION:-latest}"
if [ "$want" = latest ]; then
    url=https://pypi.org/pypi/Red-DiscordBot/json
else
    url="https://pypi.org/pypi/Red-DiscordBot/$want/json"
fi
code=$(curl -sSL -o $work/red.json -w '%{http_code}' "$url") || fail "PyPI can't be reached right now. Reinstall to try again."
[ "$code" = 404 ] && fail "Red-DiscordBot has no version $want. Set Version to latest, or to a release such as 3.5.24."
[ "$code" = 200 ] || fail "PyPI can't be reached right now (HTTP $code). Reinstall to try again."
version=$(jq -r .info.version $work/red.json)
echo "$version" > .red-version
mkdir -p data
echo "Installed Red-DiscordBot $version. It's set up when the server starts."

variables.name: Discord bot token
variables.description: The bot's token, from the Discord Developer Portal.

variables.name: Prefix
variables.description: What commands start with in Discord, such as . or !.

variables.name: Owner
variables.description: The Discord user ID of the bot's owner. Empty makes the owner of the bot's Discord application the owner.

variables.name: Version
variables.description: The Red-DiscordBot version to install, such as 3.5.24, or latest. Reinstall to change it.
